dossier.architecture: Compact low-motor swerve, mecanum collector and high-inertia adjustable-hood shooter.

subsystems.drivetrain: Inverted modules move motors down into frame volume.
subsystems.intake: Pneumatic mecanum pickup; larger commercial wheels outperformed smaller printed candidates.
subsystems.transfer: Top-driven path runs over the battery to save space; long belts locate feeder motor where packaging permits.
subsystems.scoring: Large flywheel and long wrap preserve energy for two rapid shots; printed adjustable hood.
subsystems.endgame: Two telescopic climbers; external gearboxes improve service access but exposed tubes required reinforcement.
subsystems.controls: Single-driver automated climb with an operator confirmation before committing to the full sequence.

versions: Climber tubes dented at Sundome and were replaced with thicker stock. Lightweight/no-inertia shooter experiment rejected.
dossier.analysis: Flywheel inertia answers recovery under the actual ball wrap and firing cadence. Minimum mass is not the goal if the second shot loses required energy.
limits: Only published/reviewed configurations are established; further intermediate changes may be undocumented.

context_documents.body:
# 2022-2910: Stored launcher energy and explicit hook confirmation reduce different risks

Focused study supplement. Not a full binder/CAD review, exhaustive subsystem specification, every-version history or visual interview watch.

## Published / retained construction account

The retained account describes a large flywheel/long contact wrap, powered upper contacts, an adjustable hood and a top-driven path over the battery. Climb control confirms both mid-bar hooks before starting the automatic sequence.

## Team-stated reasoning or boundary

The team connects low swerve motor placement to CG and packaging, and explains hook confirmation as preventing a one-hook climb that could break hardware.

## Engineering interpretation — analyst inference

A fast automated sequence should begin from a verified mechanical state. Similarly, high flywheel energy helps paired shots only if the feed preserves contact and motor power restores speed between volleys.

## Proposed validation — not performed

Test partial hook capture, full two-ball release and recovery at realistic battery conditions.

## Limits

Focused technical passages and the retained dossier are the evidence scope. Exact event installation, complete CAD tolerances and all intermediate revisions are not certified.
